name: broker-remove
description: Get yourself out of the data broker industry. A registry of 1,500+ brokers with working contact routes, per-broker playbooks, and the accumulated knowledge of what brokers actually do when you ask them to delete you.

plugins.name: broker-remove
plugins.description: Submit and track data deletion / opt-out requests across 1,500+ data brokers and people-search sites. Ships a registry with verified contact routes, 600+ per-broker playbooks, a corporate-family map built from state registration filings, and a catalogue of the ways removal requests silently fail.
